exposure: third trimester ultrasound timing (less than 38 weeks vs. greater than 38 weeks)
outcome: correlation between EFW and birth weight
prediction of fetal macrosomia at birth
cohort: The study included 405 fetal ultrasounds from women with suspected fetal macrosomia, where estimated fetal weight was between 4000 and 5000 g.
finding: Ultrasound performed at less than 38 weeks gestation showed significantly higher correlation between estimated fetal weight (EFW) and actual birth weight, and greater reliability in predicting fetal macrosomia at birth, compared to ultrasounds performed after 38 weeks.
birth_weight: Estimated fetal weight (EFW) between 4000 and 5000 g for inclusion criteria; actual birth weight was the outcome.
gest_age: Ultrasound scans were performed at less than 38 weeks or greater than 38 weeks gestation.
